title: Review, Classification, Hypothesis, and Determination acceptance matrix

criteria.statement: Review is defined as distinct from substantive judgment.
Concern/referral routing is distinct from evidence and findings.
Classification semantic unit is defined.
Hypothesis semantic unit is defined.
Determination semantic unit is defined.
Classification is distinct from Determination.
Hypothesis is distinct from Determination.
Determination is distinct from Response.
None of the new records becomes a student identity attribute.
No Event is required to produce a Classification, Hypothesis, or Determination.
The architecture decides whether Review is a canonical record.
Review identity and canonical storage are defined.
Review question/purpose is explicit.
Review target is explicit.
Review workflow state is defined.
Reviewer is distinct from recorder.
Evidence considered during Review can be represented.
Review may complete without a Determination.
Reporter-selected and reviewer-selected/confirmed classifications remain distinguishable.
Reviewer action does not rewrite reporter authorship.
Classification definition identity/version is preserved.
A bare mutable category label is not sufficient historical identity.
`unable to determine` or equivalent is supported.
Classification does not establish credibility, fault, intent, policy violation, or behavioral function.
Classification is Event/Participant contextual rather than a person label.
Event-level Classification does not imply every Participant.
Hypothesis is explicitly tentative.
Competing Hypotheses may coexist.
Supporting evidence is representable.
Contrary evidence is representable.
Evidence reference count does not equal evidentiary weight.
Repeated secondhand lineage does not become automatic corroboration.
Confidence/uncertainty semantics are explicitly decided.
No predictive probability or risk score is introduced.
Routine Event review is not represented as an FBA.
Cross-Event/FBA ownership is explicitly defined or deferred to #18.
Determination answers a bounded question.
Decision-maker is distinct from recorder.
Teacher-local and institutional/external decision scope are distinguishable.
Actor role/title does not establish authority.
Local-operator status does not establish institutional authority.
Authority basis is represented where required.
Policy/process basis is represented where required.
Portia does not claim to authenticate institutional authority it cannot verify.
Insufficient-information or unresolved outcomes are supported.
`not substantiated` does not invalidate source evidence automatically.
Participant-specific Determinations are explicitly targeted.
Event-level Determination does not imply every Participant.
Determination does not encode the Response or consequence.
Observation cannot automatically become Classification.
Observation cannot automatically become Determination.
Account count cannot automatically become proof.
Classification cannot automatically become Determination.
Hypothesis cannot automatically become Determination.
No automatic credibility score is introduced.
No automatic risk score is introduced.
No automatic punishment recommendation is introduced.
System processes cannot masquerade as human decision-makers.
Exact lifecycle vocabularies are defined.
Transition matrices are defined.
Invalidation is distinct from later reconsideration/reversal.
Material Classification correction uses replacement where required.
Material Hypothesis correction uses replacement where required.
Material Determination correction uses replacement.
Nonmaterial Amendment paths are explicitly bounded or absent.
Reversal preserves the prior Determination.
Reconsideration does not silently rewrite history.
Statement of Disagreement behavior is defined.
Historical references never silently follow successors.
Existing exact Portia references are reused where sufficient.
Existing sibling-module references are reused where sufficient.
Evidence role semantics distinguish supporting, contrary, and contextual use.
Referencing evidence does not copy its substantive payload unnecessarily.
Duplicate references do not inflate evidence weight.
Evidence availability is distinct from evidence truth.
Paper preallocation does not fabricate judgment records.
OCR does not establish human judgment.
Imported categories preserve uncertain review provenance.
Imported determinations preserve authority uncertainty where necessary.
Import source system does not establish correctness or authority.
Review gates before current use are defined.
Existing lifecycle infrastructure is reused where possible.
Existing correction/disagreement infrastructure is reused where possible.
Existing dependency/migration/removal contracts are reused where possible.
Existing operational contracts can target the new families.
Existing derived contracts can include the new source records.
No unnecessary parallel shared contracts are introduced.
Operational diagnostics remain privacy-minimized.
All accepted public contracts use Draft 2020-12.
All new schemas have immutable `$id` values.
Schema catalog is updated.
Valid fixtures pass.
Structural-invalid fixtures fail.
Application-invalid coverage is complete.
Existing Account/Observation tests remain green.
Existing Event/Participant/Role tests remain green.
Complete schema-validation suite passes.
Focused design document is complete.
ADR 0012 is accepted.
ADR 0001 relationship is reconciled explicitly.
Synthetic examples are complete.
Application-invalid matrix is complete.
Acceptance matrix is complete.
Validation note is complete.
Initial, pre-ADR, and final drift checks are recorded.
README and schema guide are reconciled.
All examples and fixtures use synthetic data.
No real student or sensitive real-world data is committed.
